profiles.name: Download and Use
profiles.summary: Use ViralTrac AURA directly from one local folder with no Git, hosted service, or external workspace required.

profiles.name: Private Versioned Workspace
profiles.summary: Keep the AURA product separate from an organization-owned workspace and optionally version that workspace with private Git.

profiles.name: Shared Organization Workspace
profiles.summary: Keep the AURA product separate from a private team-owned organization-memory workspace using the collaboration/versioning infrastructure that fits the organization.

invariant: All profiles use the same AURA architecture and organization-memory semantics. Git, Obsidian, hosted storage, collaboration infrastructure, and external workspaces are optional ways to store, review, synchronize, or share organization-owned AURA state; they do not become AURA runtime or execution dependencies.
